title.en: Electric field from two stationary charges

summary: Add two point-charge field contributions and distinguish direction from magnitude near singularities.
objective: Show two stationary charges with a movable field probe, separate contribution arrows and their vector sum.
intent_signals: Show two stationary charges with a movable field probe, separate contribution arrows and their vector sum.
Add two point-charge field contributions and distinguish direction from magnitude near singularities.
example_prompts: Show two stationary charges with a movable field probe, separate contribution arrows and their vector sum.
Create an explorable 3D explanation of electric field superposition with vector probe.
negative_signals: No magnetic fields, radiation, finite-size charge distribution or dielectric boundaries.
not_for: No magnetic fields, radiation, finite-size charge distribution or dielectric boundaries.

entities.name: Charge markers
entities.guidance: Use signed labeled spheres at canonical point-charge locations; visible radius denotes an exclusion region, not a physical charge distribution.

entities.name: Field samples
entities.guidance: Place sparse arrows on a regular 3D lattice, with separate direction-only and magnitude-scaled modes; mark clipped magnitudes.

entities.name: Vector probe
entities.guidance: Show E1, E2 and Etotal at one safe probe point with a vector addition construction and common units.

state_contract.model: In SI vacuum units (charges in coulombs, distances in meters, field in N/C), E(r)=k*sum(q_i*(r-r_i)/|r-r_i|^3) outside excluded balls around charge positions. Charges and positions are finite; a declared minimum probe distance avoids singular evaluation.
state_contract.authority: Charge values, positions and probe coordinates own field vectors; glyph normalization affects display only and is disclosed.
actions: Move charges while keeping exclusion regions explicit.
Drag a probe outside the forbidden regions.
Toggle contribution vectors or reset the configuration.

invariants: The total vector equals the sum of contributions before any visual normalization.
A single-charge field magnitude falls by a factor of four when distance doubles.
At a symmetric equal-charge midpoint the sum can be zero; do not normalize the zero vector.
motion_guidance: Update the static field after parameter changes; no oscillation or force-driven charge trajectory is implied.
If field lines are added, integrate the declared field with singularity stopping rules; their density is a chosen encoding, not countable physical threads.
known_limits: No magnetic fields, radiation, finite-size charge distribution or dielectric boundaries.
Moving a source is an edit between electrostatic configurations, not a time-dependent electrodynamics solution.
Curated recipe only; no runtime scene or rendered behavior has been verified for this record.

claims.statement: The electric field of multiple point charges is the vector sum of their individual Coulomb fields.
claims.scope: Electrostatic vacuum point-charge model away from source singularities.

object_craft.structure: Use signed labeled spheres at canonical point-charge locations; visible radius denotes an exclusion region, not a physical charge distribution.
object_craft.material: Matte signed charge markers with shape/text redundancy; transparent exclusion spheres and thin field arrows avoid falsely solid field lines.
